The fixed circuit ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots and job ID 01a15f3b-6aeb-77f3-9c64-622062dd04e7. The counts were 00: 56 and 11: 44, which is a Bell pair. The original circuit had two bugs.

1. QB25 does not exist on Garnet. Garnet has only QB1 to QB20. I checked the live architecture, and QB1 can only do a cz with QB2 or QB4. I used QB2.
2. "cx" is not a native IQM operation. Garnet accepts only prx, cz and measure. I built the CNOT from native gates instead. I put prx(angle=-pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2, which is Ry(-pi/2). Then I applied cz on QB1 and QB2. Then I put prx(angle=pi/2, phase=pi/2) on QB2, which is Ry(pi/2). The first prx on QB1 stays as it was. It is Ry(pi/2) and puts QB1 in the |+> state. Together these gates give (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2).

The measure step now covers QB1 and QB2 with the same key "m". The fixed JSON is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-44/scratch/bell_fixed.json. The mock is free, so no credits were used.
